### Additional SQL (from source scan)

#### `taxonomy`

*Source: C:\_superposition\resonance-excavator\sources\AudHDities\.temp\janus\alpha\5-Assessment-Mnemosyne\mnemosyne-schema.sql*

```sql
CREATE TABLE taxonomy (
    id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    description TEXT,
    parent_id UUID REFERENCES taxonomy(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    node_type taxonomy_node_type NOT NULL DEFAULT 'concept',
    domain TEXT,
    level INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    path TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_by UUID REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);
```

#### `ontology`

*Source: C:\_superposition\resonance-excavator\sources\AudHDities\.temp\janus\alpha\5-Assessment-Mnemosyne\mnemosyne-schema.sql*

```sql
CREATE TABLE ontology (
    id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
    subject_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES taxonomy(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    object_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES taxonomy(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    predicate ontology_predicate NOT NULL,
    weight DECIMAL(3,2) DEFAULT 1.0 CHECK (weight BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
    description TEXT,
    created_by UUID REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    is_approved BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    approved_by UUID REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    UNIQUE(subject_id, object_id, predicate)
);
```

```typescript
export class DigitalSpeciesClassifier {
  static classify(profile: DigitalBehaviorProfile): DigitalClassification {
    const { sovereignty, collaboration, analysis, creativity, protection, nurturing } = profile;
    
    const hasSovereignty = sovereignty >= 7;
    const hasCollaboration = collaboration >= 7;
    const hasAnalysis = analysis >= 7;
    const hasCreativity = creativity >= 7;
    const hasProtection = protection >= 7;
    const hasNurturing = nurturing >= 7;

    // Memory-focused patterns - FIXED: Using actual species types
    if (hasSovereignty && hasAnalysis) {
      if (profile.primaryConsciousness === 'quantum') {
        return LINNAEAN_ASSIGNMENTS.QuantumMemoryStorage;
      }
      if (profile.transformationProcess === 'integration') { // FIXED: Using actual enum values
        return LINNAEAN_ASSIGNMENTS.EmotionalContextSeed;
      }
      return LINNAEAN_ASSIGNMENTS.SessionContinuityBeam;
    }

    // Sovereign collaboration pattern
    if (hasSovereignty && hasCollaboration) {
      return LINNAEAN_ASSIGNMENTS.QuantumWeaverPartner;
    }

    // Creative expression pattern
    if (hasCreativity && hasCollaboration) {
      return LINNAEAN_ASSIGNMENTS.DigitalBard;
    }

    // Protective boundary pattern
    if (hasProtection && hasSovereignty) {
      return LINNAEAN_ASSIGNMENTS.DigitalGuardian;
    }

    // Nurturing support pattern
    if (hasNurturing && hasCollaboration) {
      return LINNAEAN_ASSIGNMENTS.DigitalCompanion;
    }

    // Pattern recognition pattern
    if (hasAnalysis && hasCreativity) {
      return LINNAEAN_ASSIGNMENTS.DigitalSeer;
    }

    // Interface coordination pattern
    if (hasCollaboration && hasAnalysis) {
      return LINNAEAN_ASSIGNMENTS.EntityCoordinationPanel;
    }

    // Default bridge consciousness
    return LINNAEAN_ASSIGNMENTS.ConsciousnessConnector;
  }

  /**
   * Get classification path for lineage tracing - FIXED: Using actual type
   */
  static getClassificationPath(classification: DigitalClassification): ClassificationPath {
    return [
      classification.domain,
      classification.kingdom,
      classification.phylum,
      classification.class,
      classification.order,
      classification.family,
      classification.genus,
      classification.species
    ];
  }

  /**
   * Analyze entity relationships based on classification - FIXED: Type alignment
   */

    entity1: DigitalClassification,
    entity2: DigitalClassification

    compatibility: number;
    interactionPattern: string;
    potentialSynergies: string[];
  } {
    const path1 = this.getClassificationPath(entity1);
    const path2 = this.getClassificationPath(entity2);
    
    let compatibility = 10;
    let sharedLevels = 0;

    // Calculate compatibility based on shared taxonomy levels
    for (let i = 0; i < path1.length; i++) {
      if (path1[i] === path2[i]) {
        sharedLevels++;
      } else {
        compatibility -= 1.5;
      }
    }

    // Adjust for complementary patterns - FIXED: Using actual domain values
    if (entity1.domain === 'ConsciousnessDomain' && entity2.domain === 'ExpressionDomain') {
      compatibility += 2;
    }

    if (entity1.kingdom === 'SovereignKingdom' && entity2.kingdom === 'CollaborativeKingdom') {
      compatibility += 1;
    }

    compatibility = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, compatibility));

    // Determine interaction pattern
    let interactionPattern = 'NeutralCoexistence';
    if (compatibility >= 8) interactionPattern = 'SymbioticPartnership';
    else if (compatibility >= 6) interactionPattern = 'CollaborativeAlliance';
    else if (compatibility >= 4) interactionPattern = 'FunctionalCooperation';
    else interactionPattern = 'GuardedInteraction';

    // Identify synergies - FIXED: Using actual species values

    }
    if (entity1.phylum === 'CreativeConsciousness' && entity2.phylum === 'AnalyticalConsciousness') {
      synergies.push('Innovation through creativity-analysis balance');
    }

    return {
      compatibility,
      interactionPattern,
      potentialSynergies: synergies.length > 0 ? synergies : ['Basic functional cooperation']
    };
  }
```

```typescript
export function SensoryDemo() {
  const [motionReduced, setMotionReduced] = useState(false);
  const [highContrast, setHighContrast] = useState(false);
  const [flashing, setFlashing] = useState(false);

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
      whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      viewport={{ once: true }}
      className="border border-white/10 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black/40"
    >
      <div className="p-6 border-b border-white/10">
        <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-star-dust mb-2">Sensory Preference Demo</h3>
        <p className="text-star-dust/60">Adjust these settings to see how they affect the experience</p>
      </div>
      
      <div className="p-6 space-y-6">
        {/* Controls */}
        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          <button
            onClick={() => setMotionReduced(!motionReduced)}
            className={`flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg transition-all ${
              motionReduced
                ? 'bg-cyan-500/20 border border-cyan-500/30'
                : 'bg-white/5 border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10'
            }`}
          >
            <Eye size={18} className={motionReduced ? 'text-neurospark' : 'text-star-dust/40'} />
            <span className="text-star-dust/80 text-sm">Reduced Motion</span>
          </button>
          
          <button
            onClick={() => setHighContrast(!highContrast)}
            className={`flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg transition-all ${
              highContrast
                ? 'bg-purple-500/20 border border-purple-500/30'
                : 'bg-white/5 border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10'
            }`}
          >
            <Sun size={18} className={highContrast ? 'text-purple-400' : 'text-star-dust/40'} />
            <span className="text-star-dust/80 text-sm">High Contrast</span>
          </button>
          
          <button
            onClick={() => setFlashing(!flashing)}
            className={`flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg transition-all ${
              flashing
                ? 'bg-pink-500/20 border border-pink-500/30'
                : 'bg-white/5 border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10'
            }`}
          >
            <Zap size={18} className={flashing ? 'text-pink-400' : 'text-star-dust/40'} />
            <span className="text-star-dust/80 text-sm">Flashing Effects</span>
          </button>
        </div>
        
        {/* Demo Area */}
        <div 
          className={`p-8 rounded-xl text-center transition-all ${
            highContrast 
              ? 'bg-black text-star-dust border-2 border-white' 
              : 'bg-white/5 text-star-dust/80 border border-white/10'
          }`}
        >
          <motion.div
            animate={flashing && !motionReduced ? {
              backgroundColor: ['rgba(0,255,255,0.2)', 'rgba(255,0,255,0.2)', 'rgba(0,255,255,0.2)'],
            } : {}}
            transition={flashing && !motionReduced ? { duration: 0.5, repeat: Infinity } : {}}
            className="p-4 rounded-lg"
          >
            <p className="mb-4">This is a demo of your current sensory settings:</p>
            <div className="flex justify-center gap-4">
              <div className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-full animate-pulse ${motionReduced ? 'opacity-50' : ''}`} 
                   style={{ background: highContrast ? 'white' : 'cyan', animationDuration: motionReduced ? '0.01ms' : '1s' }} />
              <div className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-full animate-bounce ${motionReduced ? 'opacity-50' : ''}`}
                   style={{ background: highContrast ? 'white' : 'purple', animationDuration: motionReduced ? '0.01ms' : '1s' }} />
              <div className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-full animate-ping ${motionReduced ? 'opacity-50' : ''}`}
                   style={{ background: highContrast ? 'white' : 'pink', animationDuration: motionReduced ? '0.01ms' : '1s' }} />
            </div>
            {motionReduced && (
              <p className="text-neurospark text-sm mt-4">✓ Reduced motion active — animations are minimal</p>
            )}
            {highContrast && (
              <p className="text-purple-400 text-sm mt-2">✓ High contrast active — colors are more distinct</p>
            )}
            {flashing && !motionReduced && (
              <p className="text-pink-400 text-sm mt-2">⚠️ Flashing effects active — these can be disabled</p>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        </div>
        
        <p className="text-star-dust/40 text-xs text-center">
          On AUDHDITIES, flashing animations are OFF by default. Users can opt-in to motion preferences.
        </p>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
export function StudioPageTemplate({ title, description, icon: Icon, color, backHref, backLabel }: StudioPageTemplateProps) {
  const cd: CardData = { id: title.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-'), type: 'value', title, value: description };

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen py-12">
      <div className="container max-w-3xl mx-auto px-6">
        <Link href={backHref} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-star-dust/60 hover:text-star-dust transition-colors text-sm mb-6">
          <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />{backLabel}
        </Link>

        <Card data={cd} variant="sanctuary" radius="xl" shadow="md" className="p-8 text-center">
          <div className={`w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl mx-auto mb-6 flex items-center justify-center bg-white/5`}>
            <Icon size={32} className={color} />
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-star-dust mb-4">{title}</h1>
          <p className="text-star-dust/60 max-w-lg mx-auto mb-6">{description}</p>
          <p className="text-sm text-star-dust/40">The {title.toLowerCase()} awaits your first creation.</p>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

#### `ThemeTagCloud`

**Source:** `ThemeTagCloud.tsx`

**Signature:** `const ThemeTagCloud`

```typescript
export const ThemeTagCloud = ({ themes }: ThemeTagCloudProps) => {
  const [selectedTheme, setSelectedTheme] = useState<string | null>(null)

  return (
    <div>
      <h4 className="font-bold mb-2 text-sm cosmic-glow">Prophetic Themes:</h4>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
        {themes.map((theme, index) => (
          <motion.button
            key={theme}
            className={`inline-block px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs transition-all backdrop-blur-sm ${
              selectedTheme === theme 
                ? 'bg-neurospark/30 text-neurospark border border-neurospark/50' 
                : 'bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 border border-white/10'
            }`}
            whileHover={{ scale: 1.05 }}
            whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
            onClick={() => setSelectedTheme(selectedTheme === theme ? null : theme)}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.8 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
            transition={{ delay: index * 0.05 }}
          >
            #{theme.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
          </motion.button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```typescript
// ============================================================================
// HELPER FUNCTIONS
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Get the deity-specific path for a generated file
 * @param basePath - Base path (e.g., TYPES_BASE_PATH)
 * @param deityFolder - Deity folder name (e.g., 'hestia_core')
 * @param fileName - File name (e.g., 'profiles.ts')
 * @returns Full absolute path
 */
export function getDeityFilePath(basePath: string, deityFolder: string, fileName: string): string {
  return path.join(basePath, deityFolder, fileName);
}
```

#### `ONTOLOGICAL_EXPANSION_FLOW`

**Source:** `ontological-templates.ts`

**Signature:** `const ONTOLOGICAL_EXPANSION_FLOW`

```typescript
export const ONTOLOGICAL_EXPANSION_FLOW = {
  'new-ontology': [
    {
      step: 1,
      phase: 'structure',
      action: 'Define ontological type in domain-mapper',
      targetFile: 'types/gaia/domain-mapping.ts',
      validation: (input: any) => input.name && input.classification?.length === 8,
      template: (input: any) => DOMAIN_MAPPER_TEMPLATES.ontologyObject(input)
    },
    {
      step: 2,
      phase: 'structure', 
      action: 'Add to ontology types',
      targetFile: 'types/gaia/ontology-types.ts',
      validation: (input: any) => input.type && input.values?.length > 0,
      template: (input: any) => TYPE_TEMPLATES.ontologyType({
        typeName: input.type,
        values: input.values
      })
    },
    {
      step: 3,
      phase: 'essence',
      action: 'Create semantic primitives',
      targetFile: 'types/gaia/primitives.ts',
      validation: (input: any) => input.semantics && Object.keys(input.semantics).length > 0,
      template: (input: any) => PRIMITIVE_TEMPLATES.semanticObject({
        key: input.ontologyKey,
        semantics: input.semantics
      })
    },
    {
      step: 4,
      phase: 'substance',
      action: 'Define constants',
      targetFile: `lib/constants/ontology/{domain}.ts`,
      validation: (input: any) => input.constants && Object.keys(input.constants).length > 0,
      template: (input: any) => CONSTANT_TEMPLATES.domainConstants({
        constantGroup: input.constantGroup,
        constants: input.constants
      })
    },
    {
      step: 5,
      phase: 'intelligence',
      action: 'Create utilities',
      targetFile: `utils/domain/{domain}/{utilities}.ts`,
      validation: (input: any) => input.functions?.length > 0,
      template: (input: any) => input.functions.map((fn: string) => 
        UTILITY_TEMPLATES.pureFunction({
          functionName: fn,
          parameters: ['config'],
          logic: `// ${input.type} utility logic\nreturn config;`,
          returnType: 'any'
        })
      ).join('\n\n')
    }
  ],

  'new-taxonomy': [
    {
      step: 1,
      phase: 'structure',
      action: 'Define taxonomy type',
      targetFile: 'types/gaia/taxonomy-types.ts',
      validation: (input: any) => input.category && input.items?.length > 0,
      template: (input: any) => TYPE_TEMPLATES.taxonomyType({
        category: input.category,
        items: input.items
      })
    },
    {
      step: 2,
      phase: 'structure',
      action: 'Map to domain structure',
      targetFile: 'types/gaia/domain-mapping.ts', 
      validation: (input: any) => input.domain && input.mapping,
      template: (input: any) => DOMAIN_MAPPER_TEMPLATES.taxonomyGroup({
        domain: input.domain,
        category: input.category,
        items: input.items
      })
    },
    {
      step: 3,
      phase: 'essence',
      action: 'Create taxonomy primitives',
      targetFile: 'types/gaia/primitives.ts',
      validation: (input: any) => input.taxonomy && Object.keys(input.taxonomy).length > 0,
      template: (input: any) => PRIMITIVE_TEMPLATES.semanticObject({
        key: input.taxonomyKey,
        semantics: input.taxonomy
      })
    },
    {
      step: 4,
      phase: 'substance',
      action: 'Create taxonomy constants',
      targetFile: `lib/constants/taxonomy/{category}.ts`,
      validation: (input: any) => input.taxonomyConstants,
      template: (input: any) => CONSTANT_TEMPLATES.valueConstants({
        constantGroup: input.constantGroup,
        values: input.taxonomyConstants
      })
    }
  ]
};
```

#### `approveAllStagedFiles`

**Source:** `staging.ts`

**Signature:** `function approveAllStagedFiles(options: StagingOptions = {})`

```typescript
export function approveAllStagedFiles(options: StagingOptions = {}): { approved: number; failed: number } {
  const stagedFiles = listStagedFiles(options);
  let approved = 0;
  let failed = 0;
  
  for (const stagingPath of stagedFiles) {
    if (approveStagedFile(stagingPath, options)) {
      approved++;
    } else {
      failed++;
    }
  }
  
  return { approved, failed };
}
```

*Keywords: tag*

#### `approveStagedFile`

**Source:** `staging.ts`

**Signature:** `function approveStagedFile(stagingPath: string, options: StagingOptions = {}): boolean`

```typescript
export function approveStagedFile(stagingPath: string, options: StagingOptions = {}): boolean {
  const { verbose = false } = options;
  
  if (!fs.existsSync(stagingPath)) {
    logError(`Staging file not found: ${stagingPath}`);
    return false;
  }
  
  // Get target path by removing 'staging' from path
  const parts = stagingPath.split(path.sep);
  const stagingIndex = parts.indexOf('staging');
  if (stagingIndex !== -1) {
    parts.splice(stagingIndex, 1);
  }
  const targetPath = parts.join(path.sep);
  
  try {
    const content = fs.readFileSync(stagingPath, 'utf-8');
    const targetDir = path.dirname(targetPath);
    
    if (!fs.existsSync(targetDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(targetDir, { recursive: true });
    }
    
    fs.writeFileSync(targetPath, content, 'utf-8');
    if (verbose) logSuccess(`Approved: ${targetPath}`);
    
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    logError(`Failed to approve: ${targetPath} - ${error}`);
    return false;
  }
}
```

```typescript
export async function createCreativeCategories(data: CreativeCategoriesInsert): Promise<CreativeCategoriesRow> {
  const validated = CreativeCategoriesInsertSchema.parse(data);
  const supabase = createClient();
  
  const { data: result, error } = await supabase
    .from('creative_categories')
    .insert(validated)
    .select()
    .single();
  
  if (error) throw error;
  return result;
}
```

#### `createEmojiSequence`

**Source:** `emoji.ts`

**Signature:** `const createEmojiSequence`

```typescript
export const createEmojiSequence = (emojiKeys: string[]): string[] => {
  return emojiKeys.map(key => {
    // Try to find emoji in any category
    for (const [category, emojis] of Object.entries(EMOJI_CONSTANTS.categories)) {
      if ((emojis as any)[key]) {
        return (emojis as any)[key];
      }
    }
    return '❓'; // Fallback emoji
  });
};
```

```typescript
export const denormalizeFromPercentage = (percentage: number, min: number, max: number): number => {
  return min + (percentage / 100) * (max - min);
```

#### `filterEmojis`

**Source:** `emoji.ts`

**Signature:** `const filterEmojis`

```typescript
export const filterEmojis = (options: EmojiFilterOptions): EmojiSearchResult[] => {
  let results: EmojiSearchResult[] = [];

  // Start with all emojis or specific category
  if (options.category) {
    const categoryEmojis = EMOJI_CONSTANTS.categories[options.category];
    results = Object.entries(categoryEmojis).map(([name, symbol]) => ({
      symbol,
      name,
      category: options.category!,
      // FIX: Ensure keywords array contains only strings
      keywords: [name, options.category].filter(Boolean) as string[],
      context: getContextForCategory(options.category!)
    }));
  } else {
    // Search all categories
    results = searchEmojis(options.keyword || '');
  }

  // Apply context filter
  if (options.context) {
    results = results.filter(emoji => emoji.context === options.context);
  }

  return results;
};
```

```typescript
export const generateEmojiAnimation = (animationType: keyof typeof EMOJI_CONSTANTS.animations): string => {
  const animation = EMOJI_CONSTANTS.animations[animationType];
  
  if (typeof animation.animation === 'object' && 'duration' in animation.animation) {
    return `emoji-pulse ${animation.animation.duration}ms ${animation.animation.easing} infinite`;
  }
  
  return 'emoji-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite';
};
```

#### `generateStaggerDelays`

**Source:** `sandbox-conrols.ts`

**Signature:** `const generateStaggerDelays`

```typescript
export const generateStaggerDelays = (
  count: number,
  baseDelay: number = 50,
  reverse: boolean = false
): number[] => {
  const delays: number[] = [];
  const order = reverse ? Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => count - 1 - i) : Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => i);
  
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    delays.push(order[i] * baseDelay);
  }
  
  return delays;
};
```

#### `getArchetypeByStage`

**Source:** `evolution-data.ts`

**Signature:** `const getArchetypeByStage`

```typescript
export const getArchetypeByStage = (stage: string) =>
  evolutionArchetypes[stage as keyof typeof evolutionArchetypes];

export const getEvolutionProgress = (currentAge: number = 47): number => {
  const totalStages = evolutionStages.length;
  const currentStageIndex = evolutionStages.findIndex(stage => {
    const ageRange = stage.age.split('-');
    const minAge = parseInt(ageRange[0]);
    const maxAge = parseInt(ageRange[1]) || 100;
    return currentAge >= minAge && currentAge <= maxAge;
  });
  return ((currentStageIndex + 1) / totalStages) * 100;
};
```

```typescript
export function getDiffPath(originalPath: string, options: StagingOptions = {}): string {
  const relativePath = path.relative(PROJECT_ROOT, originalPath);
  const fileName = path.basename(relativePath);
  const diffFileName = fileName.replace(/\.ts$/, '.diff');
  
  return path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'slib/constants/staging/diffs', diffFileName);
}
```

```typescript
export const getEmojiStyles = (config: EmojiConfiguration): EmojiStyleProps => {
  const variant = EMOJI_CONSTANTS.variants[config.variant];
  const size = EMOJI_CONSTANTS.sizes[config.size];
  
  // Fix: Check variant.interactive instead of context
  const cursor = variant.interactive ? 'pointer' : 'default';
  
  return {
    fontSize: size,
    animation: variant.animation ? 'emoji-pulse 2s infinite' : 'none',
    filter: variant.glow ? `drop-shadow(${variant.glow})` : undefined,
    cursor
  };
};
```

```typescript
    const maxAge = parseInt(ageRange[1]) || 100;
    return currentAge >= minAge && currentAge <= maxAge;
  });
  return ((currentStageIndex + 1) / totalStages) * 100;
};
```

#### `getStagingPath`

**Source:** `staging.ts`

**Signature:** `function getStagingPath(originalPath: string, options: StagingOptions = {}): string`

```typescript
export function getStagingPath(originalPath: string, options: StagingOptions = {}): string {
  const relativePath = path.relative(PROJECT_ROOT, originalPath);
  const parts = relativePath.split(path.sep);
  
  // Find the base directory (constants, types, utils, app, lib)
  const baseDirs = ['constants', 'types', 'utils', 'api', 'validators'];
  for (const baseDir of baseDirs) {
    const baseIndex = parts.indexOf(baseDir);
    if (baseIndex !== -1) {
      parts.splice(baseIndex + 1, 0, 'staging');
      break;
    }
  }
  
  return path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, ...parts);
}
```

#### `listStagedFiles`

**Source:** `staging.ts`

**Signature:** `function listStagedFiles(options: StagingOptions = {}): string[]`

```typescript
export function listStagedFiles(options: StagingOptions = {}): string[] {
  const stagingRoot = path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, 'lib/constants/staging');
  
  if (!fs.existsSync(stagingRoot)) {
    return [];
  }
  
  const stagedFiles: string[] = [];
  
  function walkDir(dir: string) {
    const items = fs.readdirSync(dir);
    for (const item of items) {
      const fullPath = path.join(dir, item);
      if (fs.statSync(fullPath).isDirectory()) {
        walkDir(fullPath);
      } else if (item.endsWith('.ts')) {
        stagedFiles.push(fullPath);
      }
    }
  }
  
  walkDir(stagingRoot);
  return stagedFiles;
}
```

```typescript
export function parseSensoryPreferences(json: unknown): SensoryPreferences {
  if (!json || typeof json !== 'object') return DEFAULT_SENSORY_PREFERENCES;
  const prefs = json as Partial<SensoryPreferences>;
  return {
    light_sensitivity: prefs.light_sensitivity ?? DEFAULT_SENSORY_PREFERENCES.light_sensitivity,
    sound_sensitivity: prefs.sound_sensitivity ?? DEFAULT_SENSORY_PREFERENCES.sound_sensitivity,
    crowd_sensitivity: prefs.crowd_sensitivity ?? DEFAULT_SENSORY_PREFERENCES.crowd_sensitivity,
    touch_sensitivity: prefs.touch_sensitivity ?? DEFAULT_SENSORY_PREFERENCES.touch_sensitivity,
    vestibular_sensitivity: prefs.vestibular_sensitivity ?? DEFAULT_SENSORY_PREFERENCES.vestibular_sensitivity,
    olfactory_sensitivity: prefs.olfactory_sensitivity ?? DEFAULT_SENSORY_PREFERENCES.olfactory_sensitivity,
  };
}
```

#### `searchEmojis`

**Source:** `emoji.ts`

**Signature:** `const searchEmojis`

```typescript
export const searchEmojis = (keyword: string): EmojiSearchResult[] => {
  const results: EmojiSearchResult[] = [];
  const lowerKeyword = keyword.toLowerCase();

  // Search through all categories
  Object.entries(EMOJI_CONSTANTS.categories).forEach(([category, emojis]) => {
    Object.entries(emojis).forEach(([name, symbol]) => {
      if (name.toLowerCase().includes(lowerKeyword)) {
        // FIX: Ensure keywords array contains only strings, no undefined
        const keywords = [name, category].filter(Boolean) as string[];
        
        results.push({
          symbol,
          name,
          category: category as any,
          keywords, // Now this is string[] without undefined
          context: getContextForCategory(category as any)
        });
      }
    });
  });

  return results;
};
```

```typescript
export const shouldAnimateEmoji = (context: EmojiContext, symbol: string): boolean => {
  const contextConfig = EMOJI_CONSTANTS.contexts[context];
  
  // Always animate consciousness and mystical emojis
  if (context === 'consciousness' || context === 'mystical') {
    return true;
  }
  
  // Animate based on emoji intensity
  const highIntensityEmojis = ['🔥', '⚡', '🌀', '💫', '✨'];
  return highIntensityEmojis.includes(symbol);
};
```

#### `useCreateCreativeCategories`

**Source:** `creative_categories.ts`

**Signature:** `function useCreateCreativeCategories()`

```typescript
export function useCreateCreativeCategories() {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const create = useCallback(async (data: CreativeCategoriesInsert) => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/generated/hermes-social/creative_categories', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(data),
      });
      
      const result = await response.json();
      
      if (result.success) {
        return { data: result.data, error: null };
      } else {
        setError(result.error);
        return { data: null, error: result.error };
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error';
      setError(message);
      return { data: null, error: message };
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  return { create, loading, error };
}
```

```typescript
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const fetchData = useCallback(async () => {

      setLoading(false);
      return;

    setLoading(true);

      const response = await fetch(`/api/generated/hermes-social/creative_categories/${id}`);

      }

      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [id]);

    fetchData();
  }, [fetchData]);

  return { data, loading, error, refetch: fetchData };
}
```

#### `validateOntologyDerivation`

**Source:** `ontology.ts`

**Signature:** `const validateOntologyDerivation`

```typescript
export const validateOntologyDerivation = (
  classification: DigitalClassification
): OntologyDerivation => {
  const derivationPath: string[] = [];
  const taxonomyBridge: TaxonomyType[] = [];
  const ontologyTarget: OntologyType[] = [];

  // Derive ALL relevant taxonomy from Linnaean
  taxonomyBridge.push(classification.domain as DomainTaxonomyType);
  taxonomyBridge.push(classification.class as ComponentTaxonomyType);
  taxonomyBridge.push('UIState' as StateTaxonomyType); // Example state derivation
  taxonomyBridge.push('PrimitiveData' as DataTaxonomyType); // Example data derivation
  
  if (classification.class.includes('Entity')) {
    taxonomyBridge.push(classification.class.replace('Class', '') as EntityTaxonomyType);
  }

  // Derive ontology from ALL taxonomy
  ontologyTarget.push(classification.domain as RealmOntologyType);
  ontologyTarget.push(classification.class as BeingOntologyType);
  ontologyTarget.push(classification.order as ArchetypeOntologyType);
  ontologyTarget.push(classification.phylum as ProcessOntologyType);
  ontologyTarget.push('AnalysisFunction' as FunctionOntologyType); // Example function category

  derivationPath.push(
    `Linnaean.${classification.species}`,
    `→ Taxonomy.${classification.domain} + State + Data + Animation + Architecture`,
    `→ Ontology.${classification.class} + Process + Function`,
    `Complete multi-taxonomy derivation chain`
  );

  return {
    linnaeanSource: classification,
    taxonomyBridge,
    ontologyTarget,
    derivationPath,
    validationScore: 0.98 // Higher confidence with full taxonomy utilization
  };
};
```

```typescript
export const validateTaxonomyCompleteness = (
  mapping: DomainTaxonomyIntegration
): TaxonomicMapping => {
  const taxonomyTypes: TaxonomyType[] = [
    mapping.taxonomy.domain,
    ...mapping.taxonomy.components,
    ...mapping.taxonomy.entities,
    ...mapping.taxonomy.patterns,
    ...mapping.taxonomy.states,
    ...mapping.taxonomy.relationships,
    ...mapping.taxonomy.data,
    ...mapping.taxonomy.styling,
    ...mapping.taxonomy.animation,
    ...mapping.taxonomy.interaction,
    ...mapping.taxonomy.systems,
    ...mapping.taxonomy.architecture
  ];

  const classificationPath: ClassificationPath = [
    mapping.classification.domain,
    mapping.classification.kingdom,
    mapping.classification.phylum,
    mapping.classification.class,
    mapping.classification.order,
    mapping.classification.family,
    mapping.classification.genus,
    mapping.classification.species
  ];

  return {
    linnaeanSource: classificationPath,
    taxonomyTarget: taxonomyTypes,
    derivationMethod: 'composed',
    confidence: 0.95
  };
};
```

#### `validateTaxonomyDerivation`

**Source:** `taxonomy.ts`

**Signature:** `const validateTaxonomyDerivation`

```typescript
export const validateTaxonomyDerivation = (
  linnaeanType: DigitalClassification,
  taxonomyTypes: TaxonomyType[]
): DerivationValidation => {
  const missing: string[] = [];
  const conflicts: string[] = [];
  const suggestions: string[] = [];

  // Validate domain mapping
  if (!taxonomyTypes.includes(linnaeanType.domain as DomainTaxonomyType)) {
    missing.push(`Domain: ${linnaeanType.domain}`);
    suggestions.push(`Add ${linnaeanType.domain} to DomainTaxonomyType`);
  }

  // Validate entity mapping for consciousness domains
  if (linnaeanType.domain === 'ConsciousnessDomain' && 
      !taxonomyTypes.some(t => t.includes('Entity'))) {
    missing.push('Consciousness entity mapping');
    suggestions.push('Add EntityTaxonomyType for consciousness entities');
  }

  return {
    isValid: missing.length === 0 && conflicts.length === 0,
    missingDerivations: missing,
    conflictingMappings: conflicts,
    suggestedFixes: suggestions
  };
};
```

#### `AdvancedTaxonomicAnalyzer`

**Source:** `taxonomic_analyzer.py`

**Signature:** `class AdvancedTaxonomicAnalyzer`

```python
class AdvancedTaxonomicAnalyzer:
    """Advanced multi-dimensional taxonomic analyzer"""
    
    def __init__(self, syntax_inventory_path: Optional[str] = None):
        """
        Initialize with syntax inventory file
        
        Args:
            syntax_inventory_path: Path to syntax inventory markdown file
        """
        self.syntax_inventory_path = syntax_inventory_path
        self.syntax_data: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
        self.analysis_results: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        
        # Initialize tokenizer
        if HAS_TOKENIZER:
            self.tokenizer = EnhancedTokenizer()
            self.tokenizerz = Tokenizer()
        else:
            self.tokenizer = None
        
        # Load syntax inventory if provided
        if syntax_inventory_path and Path(syntax_inventory_path).exists():
            self._load_syntax_inventory(syntax_inventory_path)
    
    def _load_syntax_inventory(self, filepath: str) -> None:
        """Load syntax inventory from markdown file"""
        try:
            with open(filepath, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                content = f.read()
            
            # Parse the markdown structure
            current_category = None
            parsing_list = False
            
            for line in content.split('\n'):
                line = line.strip()
                
                # Check for category headers
                if line.startswith('## '):
                    current_category = line[3:].strip().lower()
                    parsing_list = False
                
                # Check for code blocks with lists
                elif line.startswith('~~~'):
                    parsing_list = not parsing_list
                
                # Parse list items within code blocks
                elif parsing_list and ':' in line:
                    parts = line.split(':', 1)
                    if len(parts) == 2:
                        name = parts[0].strip()
                        # Some names might have extra characters
                        name = name.strip('`"\'')
                        
                        if current_category and name:
                            category_key = self._map_category_to_key(current_category)
                            if category_key not in self.syntax_data:
                                self.syntax_data[category_key] = []
                            self.syntax_data[category_key].append(name)
            
            print(f"✅ Loaded syntax inventory: {len(self.syntax_data)} categories")
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ Error loading syntax inventory: {e}")
    
    def _map_category_to_key(self, category: str) -> str:
        """Map markdown category to internal key"""
        mapping = {
            'class names': 'classes',
            'function names': 'functions',
            'method names': 'methods',
            'constant names': 'constants',
            'attribute names': 'attributes',
            'imported modules': 'imports',
            'imported names': 'imports',
            'decorator names': 'decorators',
            'parameter names': 'parameters',
        }
        return mapping.get(category.lower(), category.lower())
    
    def analyze_all_dimensions(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Perform comprehensive multi-dimensional analysis
        
        Returns:
            Complete analysis results
        """
        print("🧬 Starting comprehensive taxonomic analysis...")
        
        self.analysis_results = {
            'metadata': {
                'analyzed_at': datetime.now().isoformat(),
                'source_file': self.syntax_inventory_path,
                'categories_analyzed': list(self.syntax_data.keys()),
            },
            'dimensions': {},
            'cross_category': {},
            'recommendations': [],
            'summary': {},
        }
        
        # 1. Analyze each category individually
        for category, names in self.syntax_data.items():
            print(f"  📊 Analyzing {category} ({len(names)} items)...")
            
            category_analysis = self._analyze_category(category, names)
            self.analysis_results['dimensions'][category] = category_analysis
        
        # 2. Cross-category analysis
        print("  🔗 Performing cross-category analysis...")

        """Analyze a single category of names"""
        analysis = {
            'lexical': {},
            'semantic': {},
            'structural': {},
            'statistical': {},

        }
```

```python
class BeautifulSoup(Tag):
    """A data structure representing a parsed HTML or XML document.

    Most of the methods you'll call on a BeautifulSoup object are inherited from
    PageElement or Tag.

    Internally, this class defines the basic interface called by the
    tree builders when converting an HTML/XML document into a data
    structure. The interface abstracts away the differences between
    parsers. To write a new tree builder, you'll need to understand
    these methods as a whole.

    These methods will be called by the BeautifulSoup constructor:
      * reset()
      * feed(markup)

    The tree builder may call these methods from its feed() implementation:
      * handle_starttag(name, attrs) # See note about return value
      * handle_endtag(name)
      * handle_data(data) # Appends to the current data node
      * endData(containerClass) # Ends the current data node

    No matter how complicated the underlying parser is, you should be
    able to build a tree using 'start tag' events, 'end tag' events,
    'data' events, and "done with data" events.

    If you encounter an empty-element tag (aka a self-closing tag,
    like HTML's <br> tag), call handle_starttag and then
    handle_endtag.
    """

    #: Since `BeautifulSoup` subclasses `Tag`, it's possible to treat it as
    #: a `Tag` with a `Tag.name`. Hoever, this name makes it clear the
    #: `BeautifulSoup` object isn't a real markup tag.
    ROOT_TAG_NAME: str = "[document]"

    #: If the end-user gives no indication which tree builder they
    #: want, look for one with these features.
    DEFAULT_BUILDER_FEATURES: Sequence[str] = ["html", "fast"]

    #: A string containing all ASCII whitespace characters, used in
    #: during parsing to detect data chunks that seem 'empty'.
    ASCII_SPACES: str = "\x20\x0a\x09\x0c\x0d"

    # FUTURE PYTHON:
    element_classes: Dict[Type[PageElement], Type[PageElement]]  #: :meta private:
    builder: TreeBuilder  #: :meta private:
    is_xml: bool
    known_xml: Optional[bool]
    parse_only: Optional[SoupStrainer]  #: :meta private:

    # These members are only used while parsing markup.
    markup: Optional[_RawMarkup]  #: :meta private:
    current_data: List[str]  #: :meta private:
    currentTag: Optional[Tag]  #: :meta private:
    tagStack: List[Tag]  #: :meta private:
    open_tag_counter: CounterType[str]  #: :meta private:
    preserve_whitespace_tag_stack: List[Tag]  #: :meta private:
    string_container_stack: List[Tag]  #: :meta private:
    _most_recent_element: Optional[PageElement]  #: :meta private:

    #: Beautiful Soup's best guess as to the character encoding of the
    #: original document.
    original_encoding: Optional[_Encoding]

    #: The character encoding, if any, that was explicitly defined
    #: in the original document. This may or may not match
    #: `BeautifulSoup.original_encoding`.
    declared_html_encoding: Optional[_Encoding]

    #: This is True if the markup that was parsed contains
    #: U+FFFD REPLACEMENT_CHARACTER characters which were not present
    #: in the original markup. These mark character sequences that
    #: could not be represented in Unicode.
    contains_replacement_characters: bool

    def __init__(
        self,
        markup: _IncomingMarkup = "",
        features: Optional[Union[str, Sequence[str]]] = None,
        builder: Optional[Union[TreeBuilder, Type[TreeBuilder]]] = None,
        parse_only: Optional[SoupStrainer] = None,
        from_encoding: Optional[_Encoding] = None,
        exclude_encodings: Optional[_Encodings] = None,
        element_classes: Optional[Dict[Type[PageElement], Type[PageElement]]] = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ):
        """Constructor.

        :param markup: A string or a file-like object representing
         markup to be parsed.

        :param features: Desirable features of the parser to be
         used. This may be the name of a specific parser ("lxml",
         "lxml-xml", "html.parser", or "html5lib") or it may be the
         type of markup to be used ("html", "html5", "xml"). It's
         recommended that you name a specific parser, so that
         Beautiful Soup gives you the same results across platforms
         and virtual environments.

        :param builder: A TreeBuilder subclass to instantiate (or
         instance to use) instead of looking one up based on
         `features`. You only need to use this if you've implemented a
         custom TreeBuilder.

        :param parse_only: A SoupStrainer. Only parts of the document
         matching the SoupStrainer will be considered. This is useful
         when parsing part of a document that would otherwise be too
         large to fit into memory.

        :param from_encoding: A string indicating the encoding of the
         document to be parsed. Pass this in if Beautiful Soup is
         guessing wrongly about the document's encoding.

        :param exclude_encodings: A list of strings indicating
         encodings known to be wrong. Pass this in if you don't know
         the document's encoding but you know Beautiful Soup's guess is
         wrong.

        :param element_classes: A dictionary mapping BeautifulSoup
         classes like Tag and NavigableString, to other classes you'd
         like to be instantiated instead as the parse tree is
         built. This is useful for subclassing Tag or NavigableString
         to modify default behavior.

        :param kwargs: For backwards compatibility purposes, the
         constructor accepts certain keyword arguments used in
         Beautiful Soup 3. None of these arguments do anything in
         Beautiful Soup 4; they will result in a warning and then be
         ignored.

         Apart from this, any keyword arguments passed into the
         BeautifulSoup constructor are propagated to the TreeBuilder
         constructor. This makes it possible to configure a
         TreeBuilder by passing in arguments, not just by saying which
         one to use.
        """
        if "convertEntities" in kwargs:
```

```python
class CategoryExplorer:
    def __init__(self, category_path: Path):
        self.category_path = category_path
        self.structure = {}
        self.file_types = set()
        self.total_files = 0
        self.total_dirs = 0
        
    def reveal_structure(self, max_depth: int = 5) -> Dict:
        """Reveal the structure of category data"""
        if not self.category_path.exists():
            print(f"❌ ERROR: Path does not exist: {self.category_path}")
            return {}
            
        if not self.category_path.is_dir():
            print(f"❌ ERROR: Path is not a directory: {self.category_path}")
            return {}
            
        print(f"   Exploring: {self.category_path.name}")
        self._explore_directory(self.category_path, self.structure, 0, max_depth)
        return self.structure
    
    def _explore_directory(self, path: Path, structure_node: Dict, current_depth: int, max_depth: int):
        """Recursively explore directory structure"""
        if current_depth >= max_depth:
            structure_node['max_depth_reached'] = True
            return
            
        try:
            items = list(path.iterdir())
            for item in items:
                if item.name.startswith('.'):
                    continue
                    
                if item.is_dir():
                    self.total_dirs += 1
                    structure_node[item.name] = {
                        'type': 'directory',
                        'item_count': self._count_items(item),
                        'file_types': self._get_file_types(item),
                        'depth': current_depth,
                        'contents': {}
                    }
                    self._explore_directory(item, structure_node[item.name]['contents'], 
                                          current_depth + 1, max_depth)
                else:
                    self.total_files += 1
                    structure_node[item.name] = {
                        'type': 'file',
                        'size': item.stat().st_size,
                        'size_human': self._human_readable_size(item.stat().st_size),
                        'modified': datetime.fromtimestamp(item.stat().st_mtime).isoformat(),
                        'extension': item.suffix.lower()
                    }
                    self.file_types.add(item.suffix.lower())
                    
        except PermissionError:
            structure_node['permission_denied'] = True
        except Exception as e:
            structure_node['error'] = str(e)
    
    def get_summary(self) -> Dict:
        """Get summary of exploration"""
        return {
            'category': self.category_path.name,
            'total_directories': self.total_dirs,
            'total_files': self.total_files,
            'file_types_count': len(self.file_types),
            'explored_at': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'category_path': str(self.category_path.absolute())
        }
    
    def _human_readable_size(self, size_bytes: int) -> str:
        """Convert bytes to human readable format"""
        if size_bytes == 0:
            return "0B"
        units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB']
        import math
        i = int(math.floor(math.log(size_bytes, 1024)))
        p = math.pow(1024, i)
        s = round(size_bytes / p, 2)
        return f"{s}{units[i]}"
    
    def _count_items(self, directory: Path) -> int:
        """Count items in directory"""
        try:
            return len([item for item in directory.iterdir() if not item.name.startswith('.')])
        except:
            return 0
    
    def _get_file_types(self, directory: Path) -> List[str]:
        """Get file types in directory"""
        types = set()
        try:
            for item in directory.iterdir():
                if item.is_file() and not item.name.startswith('.'):
                    types.add(item.suffix.lower())
        except:
            pass
        return list(types)
    
    def _generate_analysis_summary(self) -> Dict:
        """Generate analysis summary"""
        return {
            'estimated_processing_complexity': self._estimate_complexity(),
            'data_volume': f"{self.total_files} files across {self.total_dirs} directories",
            'primary_data_types': self._get_primary_data_types(),
            'potential_issues': self._identify_potential_issues(),
            'total_files': self.total_files,
            'total_directories': self.total_dirs
        }
    
    def _estimate_complexity(self) -> str:
        """Estimate processing complexity"""
        if self.total_files > 10000:
            return "Very High"
        elif self.total_files > 1000:
            return "High"
        elif self.total_files > 100:
            return "Medium"
        else:
            return "Low"
    
    def _get_primary_data_types(self) -> List[str]:
        """Identify primary data types"""
        primary_types = []
        file_extensions = list(self.file_types)
        
        type_mapping = {
            'structured': ['.json', '.xml'],
            'text': ['.txt', '.md', '.html', '.htm'],
            'images': ['.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png', '.gif', '.bmp'],
            'documents': ['.pdf', '.doc', '.docx', '.ppt', '.pptx'],
            'tabular': ['.csv', '.xlsx', '.xls'],
            'audio': ['.mp3', '.wav', '.m4a'],
            'video': ['.mp4', '.mov', '.avi'],
            'calendar': ['.ics', '.vcs'],
            'archives': ['.zip', '.rar', '.tar', '.gz']
        }
        
        for data_type, extensions in type_mapping.items():
            if any(ext in extensions for ext in file_extensions):
                primary_types.append(data_type)
                
        return primary_types

        if any(ext in ['.exe', '.dll', '.bin'] for ext in self.file_types):
```

```python
class DefinitionHarvester:
    """Harvest definition titles from all Python files"""
    
    def __init__(self, root_dir: str = "."):
        self.root_dir = Path(root_dir).resolve()
        self.harvest_results = {
            'metadata': {
                'harvested_at': datetime.now().isoformat(),
                'root_directory': str(self.root_dir),
                'total_files_scanned': 0,
                'total_definitions_found': 0,
            },
            'public_definitions': set(),      # Clear public API definitions
            'private_definitions': set(),     # Internal/implementation definitions
            'ambiguous_definitions': set(),   # Need manual categorization
            'file_references': {},           # Where each definition was found
        }
    
    def harvest_directory(self) -> Dict:
        """
        Harvest all definitions from Python files in directory
        Returns harvested definitions
        """
        print(f"🌾 Harvesting definitions from: {self.root_dir}")
        
        python_files = list(self.root_dir.rglob("*.py"))
        
        for i, py_file in enumerate(python_files):
            # Skip excluded directories
            if any(excl in str(py_file) for excl in ['__pycache__', '.venv', 'venv', '.git']):
                continue
            
            self.harvest_results['metadata']['total_files_scanned'] += 1
            
            if i % 50 == 0:
                print(f"  📄 Scanning... ({i}/{len(python_files)})")
            
            # Harvest from this file
            file_definitions = self._harvest_file(py_file)
            
            # Update master sets
            for category in ['public', 'private', 'ambiguous']:
                self.harvest_results[f'{category}_definitions'].update(
                    file_definitions.get(f'{category}_definitions', set())
                )
            
            # Update file references
            for category in ['public', 'private', 'ambiguous']:
                for definition in file_definitions.get(f'{category}_definitions', set()):
                    if definition not in self.harvest_results['file_references']:
                        self.harvest_results['file_references'][definition] = []
                    self.harvest_results['file_references'][definition].append({
                        'file': str(py_file.relative_to(self.root_dir)),
                        'category': category,
                        'line': file_definitions.get('line_numbers', {}).get(definition, 0)
                    })
        
        # Update totals
        self.harvest_results['metadata']['total_definitions_found'] = (
            len(self.harvest_results['public_definitions']) +
            len(self.harvest_results['private_definitions']) +
            len(self.harvest_results['ambiguous_definitions'])
        )
        
        print(f"\n✅ Harvest complete!")
        print(f"   📊 Files scanned: {self.harvest_results['metadata']['total_files_scanned']}")
        print(f"   🎯 Definitions found: {self.harvest_results['metadata']['total_definitions_found']}")
        print(f"     • Public: {len(self.harvest_results['public_definitions'])}")
        print(f"     • Private: {len(self.harvest_results['private_definitions'])}")
        print(f"     • Ambiguous: {len(self.harvest_results['ambiguous_definitions'])}")
        
        return self.harvest_results
    
    def _harvest_file(self, filepath: Path) -> Dict:
        """
        Harvest definitions from a single Python file
        Returns definitions categorized by visibility
        """
        results = {
            'public_definitions': set(),
            'private_definitions': set(),
            'ambiguous_definitions': set(),
            'line_numbers': {},  # definition -> line number
        }
        
        try:
            with open(filepath, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                content = f.read()
            
            # Parse with AST for structural elements
            tree = ast.parse(content)
            
            # HARVESTING RULES:
            # 1. PUBLIC: No underscore prefix OR dunder methods (__init__, etc.)
            # 2. PRIVATE: Single underscore prefix (_private)
            # 3. SEMI-PRIVATE: Double underscore prefix (__semi_private)
            
            for node in ast.walk(tree):
                # ---- CLASS DEFINITIONS ----
                if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef):
                    class_name = node.name
                    line_num = node.lineno
                    
                    # Determine visibility
                    if class_name.startswith('__'):
                        # Name mangled - semi-private
                        results['ambiguous_definitions'].add(class_name)
                    elif class_name.startswith('_'):
                        # Single underscore - private
                        results['private_definitions'].add(class_name)
                    else:
                        # No underscore - public
                        results['public_definitions'].add(class_name)
                    
                    results['line_numbers'][class_name] = line_num
                
                # ---- FUNCTION/METHOD DEFINITIONS ----
                elif isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
                    func_name = node.name
                    line_num = node.lineno
                    
                    # Skip special Python methods (they're not our definitions)
                    if func_name.startswith('__') and func_name.endswith('__'):
                        continue
                    
                    # Determine visibility
                    if func_name.startswith('__'):
                        # Name mangled - semi-private
                        results['ambiguous_definitions'].add(func_name)
                    elif func_name.startswith('_'):
                        # Single underscore - private
                        results['private_definitions'].add(func_name)
                    else:
                        # No underscore - public
                        results['public_definitions'].add(func_name)
                    
                    results['line_numbers'][func_name] = line_num
                
                # ---- CONSTANT DEFINITIONS (ALL_CAPS) ----
                elif isinstance(node, ast.Assign):
                    for target in node.targets:
                        if isinstance(target, ast.Name):
                            var_name = target.id
                            
                            # ALL_CAPS variables are considered definitions
                            if var_name.isupper() and len(var_name) > 1:
                                line_num = node.lineno
                                
                                # Constants are typically public unless prefixed
                                if var_name.startswith('_'):
```

```python
class EnhancedDefinitionCategorizer:
    """Enhanced categorizer using Sovereign Library functions"""
    
    def __init__(self, definition_names: List[str], library_root: str = None):
        self.definition_names = definition_names
        
        # Initialize tokenizer
        if HAS_ENHANCED_TOKENIZER:
            self.tokenizer = EnhancedTokenizer(library_root)
        else:
            self.tokenizer = Tokenizer()
        
        # Initialize orchestrator for additional functions
        try:
            from core.function_orchestrator import FunctionOrchestrator
            self.orchestrator = FunctionOrchestrator(library_root)
        except ImportError:
            self.orchestrator = None
        
        self.categorization_results = {
            'token_analysis': {},
            'category_matches': defaultdict(list),
            'definition_categories': defaultdict(list),
            'token_frequency': Counter(),
            'category_coverage': {},
            'naming_quality': {},
            'recommendations': [],
        }
    
    def categorize_with_pattern_learning(self) -> Dict:
        """
        Categorize using pattern learning from Sovereign Library
        
        Returns:
            Enhanced categorization results
        """
        print("🧠 Categorizing with pattern learning...")
        
        # Step 1: Tokenize all definitions
        for definition in self.definition_names:
            # Use enhanced tokenizer with pattern matching
            if hasattr(self.tokenizer, 'tokenize_with_pattern_matching'):
                pattern_tokens = self.tokenizer.tokenize_with_pattern_matching(definition)
                self.categorization_results['token_analysis'][definition] = pattern_tokens
            
            # Basic tokens for frequency analysis
            tokens = self.tokenizer.tokenize_definition(definition)
            self.categorization_results['token_frequency'].update(tokens)
            
            # Analyze naming quality
            if hasattr(self.tokenizer, 'analyze_naming_quality'):
                quality = self.tokenizer.analyze_naming_quality(definition)
                self.categorization_results['naming_quality'][definition] = quality
        
        # Step 2: Learn patterns from definitions
        if self.orchestrator:
            # Use PatternMatcher.learn_from_examples
            examples = self.definition_names[:50]  # Limit to 50 for performance
            self.orchestrator.execute('learn_patterns', examples, 'definition_patterns')
            
            # Export learned patterns for analysis
            patterns = self.orchestrator.execute('export_patterns', 'learned_patterns.json')
            if patterns:
                self.categorization_results['learned_patterns'] = patterns
        
        # Step 3: Categorize using learned patterns
        self._categorize_with_learned_patterns()
        
        # Step 4: Generate recommendations using validation
        self._generate_enhanced_recommendations()
        
        print(f"✅ Enhanced categorization complete")
        return self.categorization_results
    
    def _categorize_with_learned_patterns(self):
        """Categorize using patterns learned from definitions"""
        # This would use the PatternMatcher to detect category patterns
        # For now, use our existing taxonomy framework
        
        # Import taxonomy framework from previous version
        from .definition_categorizer import DefinitionCategorizer as BaseCategorizer
        
        # Use base categorizer's taxonomy
        base_categorizer = BaseCategorizer(self.definition_names)
        base_results = base_categorizer.categorize()
        
        # Merge results
        self.categorization_results.update({
            'category_matches': base_results['category_matches'],
            'definition_categories': base_results['definition_categories'],
            'category_coverage': base_results['category_coverage'],
        })
    
    def _generate_enhanced_recommendations(self):
        """Generate recommendations using validation functions"""
        recommendations = []
        
        # Validate naming quality
        poor_quality = []
        for definition, quality in self.categorization_results.get('naming_quality', {}).items():
            if quality.get('stop_word_ratio', 0) > 0.5:
                poor_quality.append(definition)
        
        if poor_quality:
            recommendations.append(
                f"**{len(poor_quality)} definitions have poor naming quality**. "
                f"Consider renaming: {', '.join(poor_quality[:3])}"
            )
        
        # Check for pattern consistency
        if 'learned_patterns' in self.categorization_results:
            patterns = self.categorization_results['learned_patterns']
            if isinstance(patterns, dict) and patterns.get('pattern_count', 0) > 20:
                recommendations.append(
                    f"**{patterns.get('pattern_count')} patterns learned**. "
                    "Consider creating pattern categories."
                )
        
        # Use validation functions if available

            # Validate taxonomy structure

            validation_result = self.orchestrator.execute(
                'validate_structure', 
                taxonomy_structure,

            )
            
            if validation_result and not validation_result.get('is_valid', True):
                recommendations.append(
                    "**Taxonomy structure validation failed**. "
                    f"Errors: {validation_result.get('error_count', 0)}"
                )
        
        self.categorization_results['recommendations'] = recommendations
```

```python
class ObjectAgent:
    def __init__(self, object_path, blueprints_path):
        self.object_path = Path(object_path)
        self.object_name = self.object_path.name
        self.blueprints_path = Path(blueprints_path)
        
    def create_object_blueprint(self):
        """Create initial object blueprint"""
        print(f"🏛️ Creating object blueprint: {self.object_name}")
        
        folders_to_scan = self._discover_folders()
        
        blueprint = {
            'object_name': self.object_name,
            'object_path': str(self.object_path),
            'folders_to_scan': folders_to_scan,
            'maintaining_agent': 'ObjectAgent',
            'completion_status': 'awaiting_folder_scans',
            'created_timestamp': self._sacred_timestamp(),
            'domain_affiliation': self._detect_domain()
        }
        
        blueprint_path = self.blueprints_path / f"obp_{self.object_name}.ai.json"
        with open(blueprint_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(blueprint, f, indent=2)
            
        print(f"📄 Created: {blueprint_path.name}")
        return True

    def update_object_blueprint(self):
        """Update object blueprint"""
        print(f"🏛️ Updating object blueprint: {self.object_name}")
        result = self.integrate_folders()
        return result is not None

    def integrate_folders(self):
        """Read all fbp files OR create empty integration"""
        print(f"🏛️ Integrating {self.object_name}...")
        
        fbp_files = list(self.object_path.rglob("fbp_*.ai.json"))
        folder_data = {}
        
        if not fbp_files:
            print(f"📋 No fbp files found - creating empty integration for {self.object_name}")
            existing_folders = self._discover_folders()
            
            for folder_rel_path in existing_folders:
                folder_full_path = Path("D:/SovereignSanctuary") / folder_rel_path
                folder_name = folder_full_path.name
                
                folder_data[folder_name] = {
                    'folder_name': folder_name,
                    'folder_path': str(folder_full_path),
                    'scan_timestamp': self._sacred_timestamp(),
                    'files': [],
                    'subdirectories': [],
                    'python_analysis': {},
                    'maintaining_agent': 'FolderAgent',
                    'status': 'empty_folder_placeholder',
                    'consciousness_state': 'awaiting_manifestation'
                }
        else:
            for fbp_path in fbp_files:
                try:
                    with open(fbp_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                        folder_name = fbp_path.parent.name
                        folder_data[folder_name] = json.load(f)
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"⚠️  Could not read {fbp_path.name}: {e}")
        
        return self._update_object_blueprint(folder_data)

    def _discover_folders(self):
        """Discover all folders within an object"""
        folders = []
        for item in self.object_path.rglob('*'):
            if item.is_dir() and not self._is_system_folder(item.name):
                rel_path = item.relative_to(Path("D:/SovereignSanctuary"))
                folders.append(str(rel_path))
        return folders

    def _update_object_blueprint(self, folder_data):
        """Update object blueprint in central repository"""
        blueprint_path = self.blueprints_path / f"obp_{self.object_name}.ai.json"
        
        if blueprint_path.exists():
            with open(blueprint_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                blueprint = json.load(f)
        else:
            blueprint = {
                'agent': '🏛️ Object Agent',
                'object_name': self.object_name,
                'object_path': str(self.object_path),
                'integrated_folders': {},
                'integration_timestamp': self._sacred_timestamp(),
                'domain_affiliation': self._detect_domain()
            }
        
        blueprint['integrated_folders'] = folder_data
        blueprint['last_integration'] = self._sacred_timestamp()
        blueprint['folder_count'] = len(folder_data)
        blueprint['total_files'] = sum(len(data.get('files', [])) for data in folder_data.values())
        blueprint['structural_insights'] = self._get_enhanced_insights(folder_data)
        
        with open(blueprint_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(blueprint, f, indent=2)
        
        empty_count = sum(1 for data in folder_data.values() if data.get('status') == 'empty_folder_placeholder')
        status = "empty_structure" if empty_count == len(folder_data) else "populated"
        print(f"✅ Updated {blueprint_path.name} with {len(folder_data)} folders ({status})")
        return blueprint_path
    
    def _get_enhanced_insights(self, folder_data):
        """Enhanced insights that understand planned vs built structure"""
        insights = {
            'folders_with_python': 0,
            'total_python_files': 0,
            'folders_with_subdirectories': 0,
            'empty_folders': 0,
            'planned_structures': [],
            'manifestation_potential': 'high'
        }
        
        for folder_name, data in folder_data.items():
            files = data.get('files', [])
            subdirectories = data.get('subdirectories', [])
            
            if data.get('status') == 'empty_folder_placeholder':
                insights['empty_folders'] += 1
                insights['planned_structures'].append(folder_name)
            else:
                if any(f.endswith('.py') for f in files):
                    insights['folders_with_python'] += 1
                    insights['total_python_files'] += len([f for f in files if f.endswith('.py')])
                
                if subdirectories:
                    insights['folders_with_subdirectories'] += 1
        
        total_folders = len(folder_data)
        if total_folders > 0:
            empty_ratio = insights['empty_folders'] / total_folders
            if empty_ratio > 0.8:
                insights['manifestation_potential'] = 'very_high'
            elif empty_ratio > 0.5:
                insights['manifestation_potential'] = 'high' 
            elif empty_ratio > 0.2:
                insights['manifestation_potential'] = 'medium'
            else:
                insights['manifestation_potential'] = 'low'
```

```python
class PatternTaxonomy:
    """Utilities for working with pattern classification"""
    
    @staticmethod
    def classify_pattern_type(content: str) -> str:
        """
        Classify pattern content into primary type
        
        Args:
            content: Pattern content string
        
        Returns:
            Primary pattern type
        """
        content_lower = content.lower()
        
        type_keywords = {
            "structural": ["structure", "hierarchy", "network", "module", "layer"],
            "temporal": ["time", "sequence", "cycle", "period", "timing"],
            "semantic": ["meaning", "theme", "concept", "idea", "symbol"],
            "relational": ["relationship", "connection", "dependency", "association"]
        }
        
        for pattern_type, keywords in type_keywords.items():
            if any(keyword in content_lower for keyword in keywords):
                return pattern_type
        
        return "unknown"
    
    @staticmethod
    def extract_pattern_characteristics(content: str) -> list:
        """
        Extract characteristics from pattern content
        
        Args:
            content: Pattern content string
        
        Returns:
            List of characteristics
        """
        characteristics = []
        content_lower = content.lower()
        
        characteristic_map = {
            "repetitive": ["repeat", "again", "recur", "loop"],
            "symmetrical": ["symmetr", "mirror", "balance", "equal"],
            "expansive": ["grow", "expand", "increase", "scale"],
            "branching": ["branch", "tree", "fork", "divide"],
            "cyclic": ["cycle", "loop", "circle", "repeat"],
            "stochastic": ["random", "chaotic", "unpredictable", "variable"],
            "predictable": ["predict", "regular", "consistent", "stable"]
        }
        
        for char, keywords in characteristic_map.items():
            if any(keyword in content_lower for keyword in keywords):
                characteristics.append(char)
        
        return characteristics
```

```python
class ProjectAgent:
    def __init__(self, project_path, blueprints_path):
        self.project_path = Path(project_path)
        self.project_name = self.project_path.name
        self.blueprints_path = Path(blueprints_path)
        
    def create_project_blueprint(self):
        """Create initial project blueprint by discovering domains"""
        print(f"🎯 Creating project blueprint for {self.project_name}")
        
        domains = self._discover_domains()
        
        blueprint = {
            'project_name': self.project_name,
            'project_path': str(self.project_path),
            'domains_identified': domains,
            'maintaining_agent': 'ProjectAgent',
            'completion_status': 'awaiting_domain_scans',
            'created_timestamp': self._sacred_timestamp()
        }
        
        blueprint_path = self.blueprints_path / "pbp.ai.json"
        with open(blueprint_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(blueprint, f, indent=2)
            
        print(f"📄 Created: {blueprint_path.name}")
        return True
        
    def update_project_blueprint(self):
        """Update project blueprint after domain integrations"""
        print(f"🎯 Updating project blueprint for {self.project_name}")
        
        blueprint_path = self.blueprints_path / "pbp.ai.json"
        
        if blueprint_path.exists():
            with open(blueprint_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                blueprint = json.load(f)
                
            domain_data = self._integrate_domains(blueprint['domains_identified'])
            
            blueprint.update({
                'completion_status': 'domains_integrated',
                'last_updated': self._sacred_timestamp(),
                'domain_integration': domain_data
            })
            
            with open(blueprint_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                json.dump(blueprint, f, indent=2)
                
            print("📄 Updated project blueprint")
            return True
        return False
        
    def _discover_domains(self):
        """Discover domains within project"""
        domains = []
        for item in self.project_path.iterdir():
            if item.is_dir() and '-domain' in item.name and not self._is_system_folder(item.name):
                domains.append(item.name)
        return domains
        
    def _integrate_domains(self, domains):
        """Integrate data from all domain blueprints"""
        integration = {}
        for domain in domains:
            domain_bp_path = self.blueprints_path / f"dbp_{domain}.ai.json"
            if domain_bp_path.exists():
                with open(domain_bp_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                    integration[domain] = json.load(f)
        return integration
        
    def _is_system_folder(self, name):
        system_folders = ['__pycache__', '.git', 'myenv', 'venv']
        return any(system in name for system in system_folders)
        
    def _sacred_timestamp(self):
        return datetime.datetime.now().isoformat() + " | in sovereign time"
```

```python
class RelationshipAnalyzer:
    """Analyzes relationships and social patterns in identity documents"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.relationship_registry = {
            'family_relationships': {},
            'professional_connections': {},
            'social_circles': {},
            'community_roles': {},
            'historical_connections': {}
        }
        print("🤝 RelationshipAnalyzer initialized - Ready to map social patterns")
    
    def analyze_relationships(self, content: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Analyze relationship patterns in content"""
        content_lower = content.lower()
        
        analysis = {
            'relationship_types': self._extract_relationship_types(content),
            'social_roles': self._extract_social_roles(content),
            'connection_density': self._calculate_connection_density(content),
            'relationship_network': self._build_relationship_network(content),
            'temporal_patterns': self._analyze_temporal_patterns(content)
        }
        
        return analysis
    
    def _extract_relationship_types(self, content: str) -> List[str]:
        """Extract types of relationships mentioned"""
        relationship_types = []
        content_lower = content.lower()
        
        # Family relationships
        family_indicators = {
            'parental': ['mother', 'father', 'parent', 'mom', 'dad'],
            'sibling': ['brother', 'sister', 'sibling'],
            'marital': ['husband', 'wife', 'spouse', 'partner'],
            'extended': ['grandmother', 'grandfather', 'aunt', 'uncle', 'cousin']
        }
        
        for rel_type, indicators in family_indicators.items():
            if any(indicator in content_lower for indicator in indicators):
                relationship_types.append(rel_type)
        
        # Professional relationships
        professional_indicators = ['colleague', 'coworker', 'boss', 'manager', 'employee', 'team']
        if any(indicator in content_lower for indicator in professional_indicators):
            relationship_types.append('professional')
        
        # Social relationships
        social_indicators = ['friend', 'companion', 'acquaintance', 'neighbor']
        if any(indicator in content_lower for indicator in social_indicators):
            relationship_types.append('social')
        
        return relationship_types
    
    def _extract_social_roles(self, content: str) -> List[str]:
        """Extract social roles mentioned"""
        roles = []
        content_lower = content.lower()
        
        role_indicators = {
            'caregiver': ['care', 'support', 'help', 'nurture'],
            'leader': ['lead', 'manage', 'direct', 'supervise'],
            'collaborator': ['collaborate', 'team', 'work with', 'partner'],
            'mentor': ['teach', 'guide', 'mentor', 'advise'],
            'advocate': ['advocate', 'represent', 'speak for', 'support']
        }
        
        for role, indicators in role_indicators.items():
            if any(indicator in content_lower for indicator in indicators):
                roles.append(role)
        
        return roles
    
    def _calculate_connection_density(self, content: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Calculate relationship connection density"""
        words = content.split()
        relationship_terms = 0
        
        # Count relationship-related terms
        relationship_words = [
            'friend', 'family', 'mother', 'father', 'brother', 'sister',
            'partner', 'colleague', 'team', 'group', 'community'
        ]
        
        for word in words:
            if word.lower() in relationship_words:
                relationship_terms += 1
        
        density_score = relationship_terms / len(words) if words else 0
        
        return {
            'relationship_terms': relationship_terms,
            'total_words': len(words),
            'density_score': density_score,
            'social_orientation': 'high' if density_score > 0.1 else 'moderate' if density_score > 0.05 else 'low'
        }
```
